market_outlook.short_term: Markets remain under pressure from Iran conflict (oil $99-100), bond yield volatility, and tariff uncertainty. Apple Sept 9 launch and US CPI data are key near-term catalysts. Expect elevated VIX, continued oil premium, and defensive rotation. Holiday-shortened week limits volume. Fuel at record Labor Day high pressures consumer sentiment.
market_outlook.long_term: If Iran conflict de-escalates, oil normalizes and equities recover. AI capex cycle (despite data center delays) remains structurally supportive for semis. Tariff regime creates permanent reshoring theme benefiting domestic manufacturers. Bond market normalization depends on Bessent policy clarity. Insurance sector faces 2-3 year repricing cycle. 401(k)/PE allocation debate will dominate policy discourse.
